title: Comparison of transport map generated by heat flow interpolation and the optimal transport Brenier map
tldr_zh: Kim-Milman热流插值传输映射一般≠Brenier映射：高斯(drift -Ax)显式反例，标准高斯数值反例
tldr_en: Kim-Milman heat-flow transport map generally differs from the Brenier map: explicit Gaussian counterexample with drift -Ax, numerical one for standard Gaussian.
key_numbers: Standard Gaussian numerical case F=x1^4+x2^4+(x1+x2)^2 at x=(-0.5,0): DS_inf ~ [[2.303,0.441],[0.467,2.013]] non-symmetric (Sec. 4)
